1.english: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,
Master of the Day of Judgment,
Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.

1.uthmani: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
1.indopak: صِرَاطَ الَّذِيْنَ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوْبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّا࢜لِّيْنَ
1.english: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.

103.english: Lo! man is a state of loss,

103.uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
103.indopak: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ࣢ۙ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
103.english: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.

105.uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
105.indopak: اَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِاَصْحٰبِ الْفِيْلِ
105.english: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?
Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,
And send against them swarms of flying creatures,
Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,
And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?

106.english: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.
So let them worship the Lord of this House,

106.uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
106.indopak: الَّذِيْٓ اَطْعَمَهُمْ مِّنْ جُوْعٍ࣢ۙ وَّاٰمَنَهُمْ مِّنْ خَوْفٍ
106.english: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.

107.english: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?
That is he who repelleth the orphan,
And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.
Who are heedless of their prayer;

108.english: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;
So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.

109.english: I worship not that which ye worship;
Nor worship ye that which I worship.
And I shall not worship that which ye worship.
Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.

110.english: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh

110.uthmani: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
110.indopak: وَرَاَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُوْنَ فِيْ دِيْنِ اللّٰهِ اَفْوَاجًا
110.english: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,

110.uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
110.indopak: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُؕؔ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ تَوَّابًا
110.english: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.

111.english: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.

111.uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
111.indopak: مَا͏ٓ اَغْنٰي عَنْهُ مَالُهٗ وَمَا كَسَبَ
111.english: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.
He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.

112.english: Say: He is Allah, the One!
Allah, the eternally Besought of all!
He begetteth not nor was begotten.
And there is none comparable unto Him.

113.english: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak
From the evil of that which He created;
From the evil of the darkness when it is intense,
And from the evil of malignant witchcraft,
And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.

114.english: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
From the evil of the sneaking whisperer,
Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,
Of the jinn and of mankind.
